name: Hotel Helmer
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Hotel Helmer in Schwangau**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, **Hotel Helmer** in **Schwangau** offers a perfect retreat for nature lovers and culture enthusiasts alike. Just a short stroll from **Neuschwanstein Castle**, this charming hotel combines rustic elegance with modern comforts.

Indulge in authentic **Tirol** hospitality with hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Apfelstrudel**, and locally sourced meats. Our cozy restaurant serves traditional **Tirol** cuisine, while the bar invites you to unwind with a glass of regional wine or craft beer.

After a day of hiking in the **Alpen**, relax in our wellness area or explore the nearby **Innsbruck** or **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, **Hotel Helmer** promises an unforgettable stay in one of **Tirol**’s most picturesque regions.
